Root: Next.js TypeScript App Router in `src`; UI `src/components`, hooks `src/hooks`, utilities `src/lib`; pages `src/app`, APIs `src/app/api/*`; assets `public/`; scripts `scripts/` (`scripts/setup-db.ts`); standalone Vite `vite-base-template/`. Proxy `/iframe/*` → `src/app/api/iframe`.

`npm run dev` — start Next.js with Turbopack on `http://localhost:3000`.
`npm run build` — production build.
`npm run start` — run built app.
`npm run lint` — ESLint checks.
`cd vite-base-template && npm run dev` — start Vite (default `:5173`).
`npm --prefix vite-base-template run build` — build Vite app.

TypeScript: `strict`, `noEmit: true`; `@/*` → `src/*`. ESLint `eslint.config.mjs`; `<REDACTED_USER>/no-explicit-any` disabled. 2-space indentation; PascalCase components, camelCase identifiers, kebab-case files; Tailwind CSS v4.

No test runner configured. Prefer Vitest or Jest + React Testing Library; colocate `Component.test.tsx` or use `__tests__/`; cover critical components and API handlers. Commits: concise, imperative, optionally scoped. PRs must include:
Summary of changes and rationale.
Steps to test locally; attach screenshots for UI changes.
Linked issue(s) and checklist: builds, lints, and runs locally.

Environment: use `.env.local` for developer machines; do not commit secrets.
Key vars: `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` are client-exposed.
Rotate any leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys.
